web.teacher_login.description: Teacher sign-in with an animated Cues companion; uses existing Supabase teacher accounts.

web.teacher_signup.description: Teacher sign-up at /signup with the Cues companion; creates a Supabase account.

web.alert_phone.description: Optional sign-up step that saves the teacher's mobile number (user metadata alert_phone) for Photon alerts.

web.dashboard.description: Read-only teacher dashboard with Supabase seats and realtime state updates.

web.landing.description: Public landing page at /; the teacher dashboard moves to /dashboard.

vision.supabase_events.description: Send vision events and seat_state to Supabase. When off, they are written only to vision/logs/*.jsonl.

vision.hands.description: MediaPipe hand tracking, with each hand assigned to a seat.

vision.faces.description: MediaPipe face detection and the face crop per seat.

vision.gestures.description: Gesture match score per seat against the teacher's recorded examples.

vision.expression.description: HSEmotion facial-expression context per seat (supporting evidence only).

vision.raise_hand.description: Raise-hand rule per seat: a wrist above that seat's face, held briefly.

vision.task_status.description: Per-seat task status and events (attempt_success, attempt_miss, review_needed, no_progress, tracking_lost, expression_context).

vision.activity_sync.description: Read the current task from Supabase sessions.current_activity_id instead of CUES_TASK.

web.teacher_reviews.description: Read-only pending TeacherReview queue via Supabase; requires Michelle-side persistence, RLS and Realtime publication.

web.teacher_review_actions.description: Persistent review transitions; enable only after authorized Supabase RPC deployment

web.session_controls.description: Authenticated station session lifecycle and activity controls

web.person_observations.description: Read tracking_valid and show fresh, invalid, lost and paused person observations

vision.session_lifecycle.description: Follow teacher-managed station sessions, pin frame IDs and pause task processing on session end or sync loss

vision.all_scores.description: Display-only readout of every task's score for every person (overlay and vision.watch). Not sent to Supabase.

vision.custom_gestures.description: Dashboard API to create teacher-recorded gestures (/gestures). Definitions and examples stay in vision/templates/ on this laptop.

web.landing_faq.description: FAQ section and the full site footer on the landing page. When off, the landing page keeps its one-line footer.

web.teacher_profile.description: Save the signed-in teacher's display name and E.164 phone number to teacher_profiles (migration 006), and move the sign-up number there after first sign-in.

web.landing_demo.description: Landing hero shows a looping demo of the real dashboard (banner, People rows, review rows) with simulated students. When off, the hero keeps the older preview card.

web.landing_motion.description: Landing page sections fade in once as they scroll into view. When off, every section is visible from the start.

web.theme_toggle.description: Light/dark switch on the landing page, log-in, sign-up and the dashboard. The choice is saved in the browser. When off, each page keeps its default: Night for the landing page and dashboard, white for log-in and sign-up.

vision.station_config.description: Local /config endpoint: the signed-in teacher's dashboard sets this laptop's station. Vision writes nothing until a station is set. When off, the station is S1 (or CUES_STATION_ID) as before.

web.vision_station_config.description: Dashboard sends the signed-in teacher's station to the vision service on 127.0.0.1:8000/config. When off, nothing is sent.
